- Line 86: The go.mod pins go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk to v1.36.0 which is
vulnerable; update the module requirement for go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk to
v1.40.0 or later (e.g., v1.40.0+) in go.mod, then run the module update commands
(go get go.opentelemetry.io/otel/sdk@v1.40.0 && go mod tidy) to ensure the
indirect entry is reconciled and vendor/locks updated and run tests/linters to
confirm no regressions; also verify any references to google.golang.org/grpc
separately if you have additional advisory context.

In `@test/e2e/helpers.go`:
- Around line 758-776: The poll callback in RestoreNetworkPolicy currently
converts any Get error into a retry (returning false, nil); change it so only
metav1.IsNotFound is swallowed and other errors are returned (return false, err)
so wait.PollUntilContextTimeout fails fast on real read errors; make the same
change in the related MutateAndRestoreNetworkPolicy/GetNetworkPolicy polling
callbacks (the blocks around the other polling call at 782-799) so both paths
behave consistently and abort on non-NotFound read errors.
- Around line 894-939: The LogNetworkPolicyEvents helper currently does a long
wait.PollUntilContextTimeout (5s interval, 2m timeout) which can block minutes
even though missing events are non-fatal; change LogNetworkPolicyEvents to
perform a short, best-effort scan instead of long polling by replacing the
wait.PollUntilContextTimeout call with a single immediate listing pass (or a
much shorter poll window, e.g. 5–10s total) over namespaces, using the same
event filtering logic (isNPEvent, event.InvolvedObject, event.Reason,
event.Message) and preserving the found boolean and logging, so callers of
LogNetworkPolicyEvents return quickly when no events are present.
- Around line 247-254: pollConnectivity currently passes the outer ctx into
RunConnectivityCheck, allowing in-flight probe attempts to exceed the poll
deadline; change the poll callback to accept and use the provided callback
context (e.g., rename the closure parameter from "_" to "cbCtx context.Context"
or similar) and pass that cbCtx into RunConnectivityCheck so each probe respects
the poll timeout from wait.PollUntilContextTimeout; keep the outer ctx for the
overall call but ensure RunConnectivityCheck is invoked with the callback
context inside the closure.

In `@test/e2e/network_policy.go`:
- Around line 124-136: Replace the hardcoded source namespace "default" used in
the ingress probes with a test-owned namespace created and torn down by the
test: create a fresh namespace (e.g., via a helper like CreateNamespace or

that namespace name instead of "default" when creating client labels and
invoking ExpectConnectivity, and ensure you defer deletion/cleanup of that
namespace; apply the same change for the similar check around lines 276-290 so
both ingress-allow and ingress-deny probes use an isolated test-owned source
namespace rather than the cluster "default" namespace.
